ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.author: Abū Ḥayyān al-Gharnāṭī
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.speaker: author
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.claim: The command is addressed to the infernal guards: seize him, put a collar on his neck, then roast him in the great Fire.
ABUHAYYAN-FULL:v10p261#2/r1.anchor: خذوه: أي يقال للزبانية خذوه فغلوه: أي اجعلوا في عنقه غلا، ثم الجحيم صلوه

RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r8.author: Fakhr al-Dīn al-Rāzī
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r8.speaker: author
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r8.claim: The keepers command that he be seized; a hundred thousand angels rush upon him and bind his hands to his neck.
RAZI-FULL:v30p101/r8.anchor: أولها أن تقول : خزنة جهنم خذوه فيبتدر إليه مائة ألف ملك

STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.speaker: Q, Ṭ
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.claim: The commands to seize and cast the person into Hell are addressed to the angels who govern Hell.
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r1.anchor: These verses are a command to the angels who govern Hell (Q, Ṭ)

STUDYQURAN:69:30/r2.author: Seyyed Hossein Nasr (ed.-in-chief), Caner K. Dagli, Maria Massi Dakake, Joseph E. B. Lumbard, Mohammed Rustom
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r2.speaker: author
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r2.claim: For the shackles placed on disbelievers and made to course through their bodies in the Hereafter, the commentary points to 36:8.
STUDYQURAN:69:30/r2.anchor: Regarding the shackles that will be placed upon the disbelievers and made to course through their bodies in the Hereafter, see 36:8c

TABATABAI:69:27-36/r4.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r4.speaker: author
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r4.claim: The command is narrated as an order God gives the angels; ‘it is said to the angels: take him’ is understood by ellipsis.
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r4.anchor: حكاية أمره تعالى الملائكة بأخذه وإدخاله النار، والتقدير يقال للملائكة خذوه الخ

TABATABAI:69:27-36/r5.author: Muḥammad Ḥusayn al-Ṭabāṭabāʾī
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r5.speaker: author
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r5.claim: Ghullūhu is an imperative from ghull: a shackle binding hand, foot, and neck together.
TABATABAI:69:27-36/r5.anchor: و { غلوه } أمر من الغل بالفتح وهو السد بالغل الذي يجمع بين اليد والرجل والعنق

BURSEVI:v10p110/r12.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110/r12.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110/r12.claim: This is God's order to the keepers of the Fire, the zabāniya, to seize the disobedient man whose record was given in his left hand.
BURSEVI:v10p110/r12.anchor: حكاية لما يقول الله يومئذ لخزنة النار وهمالزبانية الموكلون على عذابه

BURSEVI:v10p110/r13.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110/r13.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110/r13.claim: Without delay, they gather his hands to his neck and bind them with an iron collar.
BURSEVI:v10p110/r13.anchor: بلا مهلة أي أجمعوا يديه إلى عنقه بالقيد

BURSEVI:v10p110/r14.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110/r14.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110/r14.claim: A ghull is an iron neck ring joining hand to neck and restricting head movement; the word describes placing such a restraint on someone.
BURSEVI:v10p110/r14.anchor: يقال غل فلان وضع في عنقه أو يده الغل وهو بالضم الطوق من حديد الجامع لليد إلى العنق

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r1.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r1.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r1.claim: Putting a neck collar on a slave is disliked because it is a punishment of the people of Hell.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r1.anchor: وفي الفقه وكره جعل الغل في عنق عبده لأنه عقوبة أهل النار

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r2.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r2.speaker: الفقيه
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r2.claim: A jurist says collars were customary in his time when flight was feared; unlike shackling, they are not disliked in that case, while restraint is Muslim practice for rebels.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r2.anchor: وقال الفقيه إن في زماننا جرت العادة بذلك إذا خيف من الأباق كمال في الكبرى

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.speaker: author
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.claim: The repeated ثم marks increasing terror among binding, roasting, and chain punishment, not elapsed time; the scene's threat requires no pause between torments.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r9.anchor: ثم الدلالة على تفاوت ما بين العذابين الغل وتسلية الجحيم

BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.author: İsmāʿīl Ḥaqqī Bursevī
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.speaker: ابن الشيخ
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.claim: Ibn al-Shaykh avoids coordinating both ثم and ف on one clause by positing omitted successive commands to the wardens; ثم links the commands, while ف signals immediate execution.
BURSEVI:v10p110#2/r10.anchor: قال ابن الشيخ إن كلمتي ثم والقاء إن كانتا لعطف جملة

THALABI:v10p30/r14.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p30/r14.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p30/r14.claim: At this command God addresses the keepers of Hell, telling them to seize and shackle him.

THALABI:v10p30/r15.author: al-Thaʿlabī
THALABI:v10p30/r15.speaker: author
THALABI:v10p30/r15.claim: A report says one person in Hell is set upon by one hundred thousand tormentors, torn apart in their hands, then recreated.
THALABI:v10p30/r15.anchor: ويروى أنه يجتمع على شخص واحد من أهل النار مائة ألف من الزبانية

WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r9.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r9.speaker: author
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r9.claim: God orders the keepers of Hell to seize him; a hundred thousand angels rush forward and bind his hand to his neck.
WAHIDI-BASIT:v22p175#4/r9.anchor: مائة ألف ملك، ثم يجمع يده إلى عنقه، فذلك قوله: {خذوه فغلوه

WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r2.author: al-Wāḥidī
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r2.speaker: author
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r2.claim: God commands the keepers of Hell to seize him and shackle him.
WAHIDI-WAJIZ:69:29-32/r2.anchor: { خذوه فغلوه }. { ثم الجحيم صلوه } أدخلوه.

QASHANI:69:25/r3.author: ʿAbd al-Razzāq al-Qāshānī
QASHANI:69:25/r3.speaker: author
QASHANI:69:25/r3.claim: A voice of sovereign majesty orders the angel governing the world of generation and corruption to seize and bind him in forms matching his soul's dispositions, imprisoning him in nature and restricting volition.
QASHANI:69:25/r3.anchor: والأرضية أن { خذوه فغلوه } أي: قيدوه بما يناسب هيئات نفسه

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r1.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r1.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r1.claim: The command to seize him refers to the man who had just spoken about his useless wealth and power.
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r1.anchor: Tutun onu yani öyle deyip duran kimseyi.

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.claim: These are God's commands to the keepers of Hell, phrased as an implied utterance as though addressed to the useless wealth and power mentioned by the condemned man.
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r2.anchor: Bu emirler taraf-ı ilâhîden zebânilere emirdir. O kimsenin ağzından o işe yaramayan mal ve sultana söyleniyormuş gibi hikâye suretinde mukadder kavl ile ifade olunmuştur.

ELMALILI:69:30-34/r3.author: Elmalılı Muhammed Hamdi Yazır
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r3.speaker: author
ELMALILI:69:30-34/r3.claim: The order is to bind him immediately.

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.claim: After the left-handed person's account, God orders the angels to bind his hands to his neck, take him to hell, and bind him to the criminals' long chain.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r1.anchor: Allah Tealâ görevli meleklere o günahkârın ellerini boynuna bağlayıp cehenneme götürmelerini, sonra da suçlulara ait uzun zincirdeki yerine bağlanmalarını emreder

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r3.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r3.speaker: author
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r3.claim: Because the afterlife belongs to the unseen, God explains its realities to people in this world through representative imagery.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r3.anchor: Âhiret hayatı gayb âleminden olduğu için Allah orası ile ilgili bilgileri dünyadaki kullarına temsilî olarak anlatmaktadır

KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r4.author: Hayreddin Karaman, Mustafa Çağrıcı, İbrahim Kâfi Dönmez, Sadrettin Gümüş
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r4.speaker: Râzî
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r4.claim: Razi reads similar imagery as a metaphor for sinners' deeds and inclinations and the general despair they will experience in the next world.
KURANYOLU-TEFSIR:69:30/r4.anchor: Râzî, bunun benzeri başka bir âyetin (bk. İbrâhim 14/49) tefsirinde bu tür ifadelerin, günahkârların kendi eylem ve eğilimlerini

BURHAN:v1p77/r3.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v1p77/r3.speaker: author
BURHAN:v1p77/r3.claim: A balanced cadence can be followed by a longer second clause, as in ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوى, or by a longer third clause, as in the command to take and bind the condemned man.

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.claim: The order “then the Fire, roast him” preserves the verse endings; saying “roast him in the Fire” would convey the meaning but lose their joined cadence.
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r1.anchor: ولو قال صلوه الجحيم لأفاد المعنى ولكن يفوت الجمع

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.speaker: بعضهم
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r2.claim: Some also explain the unusual order as giving the Fire particular emphasis or exclusivity.

BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.author: al-Zarkashī
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.speaker: author
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.claim: Verse-ending alignment can motivate multiple instances of fronting; when reasons conflict, the strongest governs, and when equal the speaker may choose either order.
BURHAN:v3p274#2/r4.anchor: قد يكون في كل واحد مما ذكرنا من الأمثلة سببان فأكثر للتقديم فإما أن يعتقد إعادة الكل أو يرجح بعضها

TUSTARI:69:30/r1.author: Sahl al-Tustarī
TUSTARI:69:30/r1.speaker: author
TUSTARI:69:30/r1.claim: At God's command, one hundred thousand angels rush to seize him; an angel could grasp the whole earth with its mountains and seas, then his hands are bound to his neck and he is cast into Hell.
TUSTARI:69:30/r1.anchor: فإذا قال ذلك ابتدره مائة ألف ملك، لو أن ملكا منهم أخذ الدنيا بما فيها من جبالها وبحارها

SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r1.author: al-Samīn al-Ḥalabī
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r1.speaker: author
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r1.claim: خذوه, like كلوا in the earlier verse, is understood as speech introduced by an omitted قال.
SAMIN-DURR:69:30/r1.anchor:
وقوله: { خذوه } كقوله:
كلوا
[الحاقة: 24] في إضمار القول

ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r1.claim: The command is to seize the condemned man and shackle him.
ASAD-NOTES:69:30/r1.anchor: Lay hold of him, and shackle him

ASAD-NOTES:69:30#n16/r1.author: Muhammad Asad
ASAD-NOTES:69:30#n16/r1.speaker: author
ASAD-NOTES:69:30#n16/r1.claim: The shackles are allegorical; Asad directs readers to his notes on 13:5, 34:33, and 36:8.
ASAD-NOTES:69:30#n16/r1.anchor: For an explanation of the allegory of "shackles"

SIBAWAYH:(هذابابثباتالياءوالواوفيالهاءال.author: Sībawayh
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابثباتالياءوالواوفيالهاءال.speaker: author
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابثباتالياءوالواوفيالهاءال.claim: When a long vowel precedes pronominal hāʾ, dropping its following yāʾ or wāw in connected speech is preferred; Sībawayh favors these shortened readings but accepts full realization as Arabic.
SIBAWAYH:(هذابابثباتالياءوالواوفيالهاءال.anchor: فلما اجتمعت حروف متشابهة حذفوا وهو أحسن وأكثر

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r1.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r1.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r1.claim: Supply an omitted “He says”: God addresses the keepers of Hell, telling them to take the man.
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r1.anchor: بتقدير القول أي فيقول الله تعالى للزبانية خذوه

ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r2.author: al-Ālūsī
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r2.speaker: author
ALUSI-FULL:v29p49#4/r2.claim: “Fetter him” means bind him in chains.

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r11.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r11.speaker: مقاتل
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r11.claim: Muqatil says the limbs testify against him for associating partners with God, prompting the order to the keepers of Hell to seize him.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r11.anchor: قال مقاتل: يعني حين شهدت عليه الجوارح بالشرك، يقول الله لخزنة جهنم: {خذوه فغلوه}

BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r12.author: al-Baghawī
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r12.speaker: author
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r12.claim: The command means to gather or bind his hand to his neck.
BAGHAWI-FULL:v8p212/r12.anchor: خذوه فغلوه} اجمعوا يده إلى عنقه.

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r1.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r1.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r1.claim: God addresses the keepers of the Fire, commanding them to seize the condemned person.

BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r2.author: al-Bayḍāwī
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r2.speaker: author
BAYDAWI-FULL:69:30-32/r2.anchor: يقوله الله تعالى لخزنة النار. { فغلوه }

BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r4.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r4.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r4.claim: The addressees are the zabāniya, the guards whom the condemned person had scorned when they were mentioned.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r4.anchor: أي أيها الزبانية الذين كان يستهين بهم عند سماع ذكرهم

BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r5.author: al-Biqāʿī
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r5.speaker: author
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r5.claim: They bind his hands to his neck and his feet behind his back, up toward the front of his head.
BIQAI-FULL:v8p134/r5.anchor: اجمعوا يديه غلى عنقه ورجليه من وراء قفاه إلى ناصيته

DURR-FULL:v8p273/r8.author: al-Suyūṭī
DURR-FULL:v8p273/r8.speaker: ابن جريج
DURR-FULL:v8p273/r8.claim: Ibn Jurayj reports that he was told the person seized and shackled is Abu Jahl.
DURR-FULL:v8p273/r8.anchor: عن ابن جريج في قوله: {خذوه فغلوه} قال: أخبرت أنه أبو جهل

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r1.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r1.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r1.claim: An omitted “it is said” introduces the command, which functions circumstantially with the criminal’s wish in 69:25.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r1.anchor: مقول لقول محذوف موقعه في موقع الحال من ضمير

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r2.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r2.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r2.claim: The ones ordered to seize him are the angels assigned to drive the judged toward their destination.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r2.anchor: ومعلوم من المقام أن المأمورين بأن يأخذوه هم الملائكة الموكلون

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r3.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r3.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r3.claim: Taking him means gripping him by hand.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r4.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r4.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r4.claim: The command means to put him in a neck shackle used for an offender or captive.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r4.anchor: غلوه : أمر من غله إذا وضعه في الغل وهو القيد

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r5.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r5.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r5.claim: The verb is derived from a noun and is attested only in the triliteral form; its expected doubled form may have been shortened for ease.

IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r6.author: Ibn ʿĀshūr
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r6.speaker: author
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r6.claim: The prefixed fa conveys speed: shackling follows immediately after the seizure.
IBNASHUR-FULL:v29p137/r6.anchor: وعطف بفاء التعقيب لإفادة الإسراع بوضعه في الأغلال عقب أخذه

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r1.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r1.speaker: author
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r1.claim: God, or an angel acting by His command, orders the guards to seize the offender and put a collar around his neck.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r1.anchor: المعنى يقول الله تعالى: أو الملك بأمره للزبانية، خذوه واجعلوا على عنقه غلا

IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r2.author: Ibn ʿAṭiyya
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r2.speaker: ابن جرير
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r2.claim: Ibn Jarir says the passage was revealed concerning Abu Jahl.
IBNATIYYA-FULL:v5p361/r2.anchor: قال ابن جرير: نزلت في أبي جهل

IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#2/r1.author: Ibn al-Jawzī
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#2/r1.speaker: author
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#2/r1.claim: The command means to gather or bind his hand to his neck.
IBNJAWZI-ZAD:v8p353#2/r1.anchor: قوله تعالى خذوه أي يقول الله تعالى خذوه فغلوه أي اجمعوا يده إلى عنقه

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.speaker: author
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.claim: God orders the keepers to seize him forcibly from the gathering, shackle his neck, and take him to Hell to be immersed in it.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r5.anchor: أي: يأمر الزبانية أن تأخذه عنفا من المحشر، فتغله، أي: تضع الأغلال في عنقه، ثم تورده إلى جهنم فتصليه إياها،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r6.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r6.speaker: المنهال بن عمرو
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r6.claim: Al-Minhal ibn ʿAmr says that at God's command seventy thousand angels rush to seize the condemned man, and an angel can throw seventy thousand into the Fire.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r6.anchor: عن المنهال بن عمرو قال: إذا قال الله، عز وجل {خذوه} ابتدره سبعون ألف ملك

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r7.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r7.speaker: ابن أبي الدنيا
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r7.claim: A report in Ibn Abi al-Dunya's al-Ahwāl says four hundred thousand rush him, crushing everything; when he asks why, they answer that the Lord is angry with him and everything is angry with him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r7.anchor: وروى ابن أبي الدنيا في "الأهوال": أنه يبتدره أربعمائة ألف، ولا يبقى شيء إلا دقه،

IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r8.author: Ibn Kathīr
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r8.speaker: الفضيل بن عياض
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r8.claim: Al-Fudayl ibn ʿIyad says seventy thousand angels rush when God commands that the man be seized and shackled, each wanting to put the collar on him.
IBNKATHIR-FULL:v8p215#2/r8.anchor: وقال الفضيل -هو ابن عياض-: إذا قال الرب، عز وجل: {خذوه فغلوه} ابتدره سبعون ألفا ملك،

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.claim: After describing two groups through their books, the passage warns of punishment prepared for sinners.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r6.anchor: لما تقدم ذكر حالتي الناس في الكتاب عقبه بذكر وعيد العصاة، وما أعد لهم،

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r7.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r7.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r7.claim: The command may address Hell’s keepers; alternatively each keeper gathers tormenting angels.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r7.anchor: خذوه أي: يقال للملائكة الذين هم خزنة جهنم

JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r8.author: al-Ḥākim al-Jishumī
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r8.speaker: author
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r8.claim: The command is to put shackles around his neck.
JISHUMI:v10p7063#2/r8.anchor: فغلوه أي: اجعلوا الأغلال في أعناقهم

KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.author: al-Zamakhsharī
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.speaker: author
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.claim: Repeated ثم marks the escalation between shackling, roasting, and threading him through the chain, not elapsed time.
KASHSHAF-FULL:v4p608/r6.anchor: الدلالة على تفاوت ما بين الغل والتصلية بالجحيم ، وما بينها وبين السلك في السلسلة ، لا على تراخي المدة

MUQATIL:69:25-32/r6.author: Muqātil b. Sulaymān
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r6.speaker: author
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r6.claim: The command is for Hell's keepers to bind the man's hands to his neck.
MUQATIL:69:25-32/r6.anchor: يقول الله لخزنة جهنم { خذوه فغلوه } [آية: 30] يعني غلوا يديه إلى عنقه

NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#6/r1.author: al-Nasafī
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#6/r1.speaker: author
NASAFI-FULL:v4p276#6/r1.claim: Fetter him by bringing his hands together at his neck.

QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r4.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r4.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r4.claim: One account says one hundred thousand angels rush to him and bind his hand to his neck in shackles.
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r4.anchor: قيل: يبتدره مائة ألف ملك ثم تجمع يده إلى عنقه وهو قوله عز وجل: «فغلوه»

QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r5.author: al-Qurṭubī
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r5.speaker: author
QURTUBI-FULL:69:25-34/r5.claim: Fa-ghullūhu means bind him with shackles.
